يزدوج (form VIII)
# يَزْدَوِجُ (yazdawiju) /jaz.da.wi.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
# يَزْدَوِجَ (yazdawija) /jaz.da.wi.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
# يَزْدَوِجْ (yazdawij) /jaz.da.wid͡ʒ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
